title: kei.policy-bundle/v1
description: The policy bundle a runtime installation's PEP (kei-connector-runtime) enforces (ADR-026). The root schema is the canonical JSON object served by the catalog and validated/persisted by the runtime. Transport integrity is provided by the exact-byte SHA-256 digest and authenticated HTTPS. The $id is an identifier, not a fetchable URL.

bundle_version.description: Issuance sequence for this installation. Strictly increasing, never reused; every issuance (including a re-sign with unchanged policy) takes the next value. A runtime never activates a bundle_version lower than or equal to the highest it has activated.

policy_revision.description: The workspace's policy revision this bundle was built from. Increases on every policy-affecting change in the workspace; equal across installations built from the same state. Carried to audit so a decision can be tied to the policy state that produced it.

audience.description: Who may enforce this bundle. The runtime rejects a bundle whose audience does not equal its own whoami identity.

not_after.description: Hard expiry. At or after this instant the bundle decides nothing: every call is denied with policy_bundle_expired. At most 24 hours after issued_at.

poll_interval_seconds.description: Advised polling interval. The runtime clamps it to [30, 300] and applies +/-10% jitter.

stale_after_seconds.description: How long after the last successful refresh check the runtime reports the stale_but_valid state. Enforcement continues until not_after.

subject_resolution.description: How the PEP learns a human subject's user id, link state, effective groups and org roles. v1 is always online: the PEP asks the catalog (POST /api/v1/runtime/subject-attributes:resolve) and never reads memberships from the bundle.

max_cache_seconds.description: The longest a resolved subject may be reused in memory by a long-running PEP. Per-call subprocesses do not cache.

agent_connector_bindings.description: Which connector capabilities each assigned agent is bound to. A connector call by an unbound agent is denied before policy is evaluated.
